from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial report with the key equity figure needed for classification."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the financial report belongs to")
    total_owners_equity: float | None = Field(description="所有者权益合计 (Total Owners' Equity) value in Yuan")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the financial report covers (e.g., Q1 2024, 2024 年第一季度)")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit used in the report (e.g., 元)")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the equity value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
